title: These heavy sands are language tide and wind have silted here.
html_source:
Stephen begins to meditate on how language represents a prima materia that an artist must shift and tug at to impose shape on the world. In this way, language can also be seen as Proteus.

Also it is interesting to note how this chapter exposes Stephen as a protean figure, who is struggling to find a shape for himself in this world.
